--- revoke_execute_on_model.sql
REVOKE EXECUTE ON MODEL MyModel FROM ROLE MyRole

--- AST
&ast.Revoke{
  Privilege: &ast.ExecutePrivilegeOnModel{
    Execute: 7,
    Names:   []*ast.Path{
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 24,
            NameEnd: 31,
            Name:    "MyModel",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 42,
      NameEnd: 48,
      Name:    "MyRole",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
REVOKE EXECUTE ON MODEL MyModel FROM ROLE MyRole
